name: MSAR
fullName: Mathematics and Statistics Students' Association of Rwanda
tagline: From theory to practice. From classroom to career.
description: MSAR — the Mathematics and Statistics Students' Association of Rwanda — connects 150+ students with practical data skills training (KoboToolbox, Excel, Power BI, QGIS, Python), research, mentors and career opportunities at the University of Rwanda.
home: University of Rwanda — College of Science and Technology (UR–CST)
address: University of Rwanda, Nyarugenge Campus, Kigali, Rwanda
mission: To unite and support students in mathematics and statistics through academic excellence, professional growth, and real-world applications.
vision: To become Rwanda's leading community of empowered mathematicians and statisticians.
